summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Cybin Inc. (Helus Pharma) announcing the pricing of an underwritten offering of 10,309,280 common shares at US$4.85 per share for gross proceeds of US$50 million. Cantor Fitzgerald and Barclays act as joint bookrunners. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; the proceeds fund pipeline programs and working capital. Expected close is June 25, 2026, subject to exchange approvals. No special-situation elements such as acquisition, tender, or restructuring are present.
